name: San Jacinto fault zone (Anza corridor), Southern California

fault_trace.comment: Real mapped trace, San Jacinto fault zone Anza section (incl. Clark/Hog Lake), from CA GIS GeoscientificInformation/Fault_Lines/MapServer/3, fetched 2026-07-03. Replaces the earlier 2-point hand-picked approximation (kept below as p1/p2 fallback only).

gnss.fault_azimuth_comment: PCA strike of the real Anza-section trace (was 305 deg hand-estimate)

state.recurrence_source: Hog Lake paleoseismic trenching on the Clark fault (Anza section): 3 surface-rupturing M~7.0-7.5 events c. 1210, 1530, ~1795-1800 CE; recurrence ~250-254 yr, last event ~1795-1800 -> ~227 yr elapsed as of 2026. Sourced 2026-07-03 (WebSearch), not re-verified against the primary paleoseismology paper (Rockwell/Onderdonk-type Hog Lake studies) -- treat as literature-grade estimate, not a re-derived one.
